Copy of a letter No. 374, dated 14th July 1907, from the Political Agent, Koweit, to the Political Resident in the Persian Gulf, Bushire.

I have the honour to acknowledge the receipt of your letter No. 1390, dated 26th June 1907, in the case of the negro Abdulla.

This case has now settled itself, for the negro has, of his own free will, returned to his master.

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your letter No. 374, dated 14th July 1907, and note that the negro Abdulla no longer desires a manumission certificate.
